concerns.text: Verification for T009 claims the output JSON must conform to `contracts/regression-model.schema.yaml` while also allowing an extra field (`theoretical_bound_deviation`). The schema has `additionalProperties: false`, so any extra field makes validation fail, making the verification step impossible as written.

Success Criterion SC-004 (total wall‑clock time of the pipeline vs. CI limit) is not covered by any task; there is no deliverable or verification step that records or validates the overall execution time, leaving the criterion untestable.
